description:
Embark into Karazhan at an increased difficulty! Bosses and creatures alike have become tougher than before, now boasting increased physical damage, increased magic damage and increased health, making every encounter more challenging to overcome than before!

Defeat Prince Malchezaar and claim many rewards: from Cases of Fortune, Triumphant Raider Tokens, and unique cosmetics!
